Redesign Paper Explainer into the flagship product of Repro Suite. Rebuild the whole front end with the design system and structure below. English and 中文 everywhere (keep the EN / 中文 switch). Remove every "20 seconds", "first 20 seconds free", "preview" and "full video on request" wording, and remove the in-browser draft player and the old demo list.

DESIGN SYSTEM (must match https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world/repro/index.html exactly, so all our apps look like one product)
- Light theme first, dark theme on a toggle button (☾ / ☀), remembered in localStorage key "repro.theme2".
- Light: background #FBFBFD, cards #FFFFFF, soft fill #F3F3F6, text #1D1D1F, secondary text #5C5C66, borders #E4E4EA, accent #2B59FF, accent tint #ECF0FF, success #15803D, warning #B45309, error #C62828.
- Dark: background #0B0B0E, cards #151519, soft #1C1C22, text #F4F4F6, secondary #ADADB8, borders #2A2A31, accent #7B96FF, accent tint #1B2146.
- Font Inter (Google Fonts) with Noto Sans SC for Chinese; JetBrains Mono for numbers and ids. Headlines weight 800, letter-spacing -0.035em, hero 56 to 60px on desktop. Body 15px.
- Cards radius 16px, 1px border, shadow 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.04), 0 8px 24px rgba(16,24,40,.06). Buttons are pills (radius 999px): primary = accent background, white text; secondary = white with border.
- Lots of white space, like apple.com and tally.so. One accent colour only. No gradients except a very light accent tint on one feature card.

LAYOUT
- Left sidebar 248px, sticky, full height, white, border on the right (on screens under 900px it becomes a drawer opened by a ☰ button in a slim top bar). Top: black rounded square logo with a white "E", "Paper Explainer", small grey line "part of Repro Suite".
  Group "Paper Explainer": Make a video (#make), Examples (#examples), How it works (#how), Pricing (#pricing), Feedback (#feedback). The link of the section in view is highlighted (accent tint background, accent text).
  Group "Repro Suite" (open in a new tab, with a small ↗): Paper Repro Agent https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world/repro/index.html , Benchmark https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world/repro/bench.html , Repro Lite https://reprolite-aiid.pub.atoms.world , Reading Companion https://readingcompanion-aiid.pub.atoms.world , IndexBoard https://indexboard-aiid.pub.atoms.world/b/5dhum9j5h0 , All apps https://reprosuite-aiid.atoms.world
  Bottom of the sidebar: theme button and EN / 中文 button.
- Main column max width 1040px, padding 56px 32px.

DATA (real, from our server; no API key needed, CORS is open)
Base: https://vzvyghmtsakixlhzzuol.supabase.co/functions/v1/explainer-render
- GET ?recent=1 returns a list of finished videos: {id, arxiv, title, status, videos: {en, zh, en_vertical, zh_vertical} (MP4 URLs), checks: {checked: number, removed: [strings]}, updated_at}.
- POST {"arxiv": "<id or arxiv.org link>", "visitor": "<random id kept in localStorage>"} queues a video. Returns the job {id, status: "queued"|"running"|"done"|"failed", stage, title, videos, error}. If the paper already has a video it returns it at once with "cached": true. Errors come back as {error: "..."} with status 400, 404 or 429; show that message.
- GET ?id=<job id> returns the job; poll every 5 seconds until status is done or failed.

SECTIONS (one page, in this order)
1. Hero. Eyebrow "Paper Explainer" in accent. H1 "Understand any AI paper in under a minute." Sub: "Paste an arXiv link. We turn the paper into a short narrated video in English and 中文, and check every quote and number on screen against the paper text." Buttons: "Make a video" (primary, scrolls to #make) and "Watch an example" (secondary, scrolls to #examples). Right side or below: the newest finished video from ?recent=1 in a 16:9 rounded player (HTML video, controls, muted autoplay off, preload metadata, src = videos.en, src#t=1 so a frame shows).
   Under the hero a stats strip card (like the facts strip on the Paper Repro Agent page): number of videos made, "2 languages", total quotes and numbers checked (sum of checks.checked), how many were removed by the check (sum of checks.removed length), "about 4 minutes per video".
2. Make a video (#make). Card with one input "arXiv link or id" and primary button "Make my video". After submit show a progress list with 5 steps that light up from the job's stage text: Reading the paper, Writing the script, Checking quotes and numbers, Recording English, Recording 中文, then Done. Show "Usually 3 to 5 minutes. You can leave this page open." When done, show the English and Chinese videos with tabs EN / 中文, and buttons: Download MP4, Download vertical (9:16) for Douyin / Xiaohongshu / Reels, Copy link, Share on X, Share on LinkedIn, Share on Weibo. The share link is this site with ?v=<arxiv>; opening such a link scrolls to that video and opens it. Under the result: "Was this useful?" 👍 / 👎 plus an optional comment box, saved to the feedback table (below). Free limit: 3 videos per visitor per day (the server enforces it; show its message).
3. Examples (#examples). Grid of cards (3 columns desktop, 1 on phone) from ?recent=1. Each card: video thumbnail (video element with preload metadata and #t=2, no autoplay) with a play button overlay; title (2 lines max); mono line "arXiv:<id>"; a small green pill "✓ <checked> checks passed" and, if removed is not empty, a grey pill "<n> removed by the check"; EN / 中文 toggle; share and download icons. Clicking plays the video in a lightbox (Esc to close).
4. How it works (#how). Four steps in a row (stack on phone), numbered circles: 1 Read: we fetch the paper text from arXiv. 2 Script: an AI model (DeepSeek) writes six scenes from the paper text only. 3 Check: every quote must appear word for word in the paper and every number must appear in the paper; anything that fails is removed before recording. 4 Record: neural voices narrate English and 中文 and the animation is recorded to MP4, in 16:9 and 9:16. Then a small note card "What it does not check: short labels in diagrams are summaries. It is a learning aid; read the paper for the details." Add a link card "Does the result hold? Paper Repro Agent re-runs the experiment" → Paper Repro Agent URL.
5. Pricing (#pricing). Two cards side by side. Free: US$0, any arXiv paper, English and 中文, 16:9 and 9:16 MP4, 3 videos a day. Studio: launch price US$5 per paper (accent border, badge "Launch price"): a person reviews the script before recording, 60 to 90 seconds instead of 40, your name or lab logo on the end card, captions file (SRT) for social media, delivered by email within 24 hours. Studio button "Order a Studio video" opens a form: email (required), arXiv link (required), language (English / 中文 / both), notes. Save to a new table "studio_orders" (email, arxiv, language, notes, status default "new", created_at). After saving show: "Thank you. We will email you a payment link and confirm within 24 hours." Show the count of orders so far is NOT needed.
6. Feedback (#feedback). Short form: "How useful is this?" 1 to 5 stars, "What would you use it for?" chips (Studying, Teaching, Sharing my own paper, Social media, Other), comment, email optional. Save to a new table "feedback" (rating, use_case, comment, email, arxiv nullable, kind "general" or "video", created_at). Show "Thank you" after sending, and above the form the number of feedback responses received so far.
7. Footer: "Paper Explainer is part of Repro Suite." links to All apps and Paper Repro Agent. Small grey text "Videos are made from public arXiv papers."

Keep the existing tables. Check on the built site that the examples load from ?recent=1 and play, that the stats strip shows real numbers, that "Make my video" with 1706.03762 returns the cached video at once, and that the layout has no horizontal scroll at 390px wide in both themes.

# Project Summary
Paper Explainer helps researchers promote papers with short, cinematic video previews. Visitors can watch previews, request a full video without logging in, or create an AI-generated preview for an arXiv paper. Generated previews are checked against available paper text, played in the shared 16:9 player, and saved for display on the home page. Full-video requests and preview records are stored in the database. Payments are not part of this version.

The site includes three demo papers, English and Chinese narration and subtitles, and light and dark themes. Made previews have no recorded narration; the player uses browser speech synthesis. AI-generated scripts can contain mistakes and should be checked before sharing.

Demo assets include `.html` copies of the JSON and Markdown files. The app uses these copies because the production server may return the app page instead of the requested file for `.json` and `.md` paths.

# Project Module Description
- **Home (`frontend/src/pages/Index.tsx`)** — Presents the three demo papers, an arXiv ID or link input, and the latest saved previews.
- **Watch (`frontend/src/pages/Watch.tsx`)** — Plays a demo paper and provides language switching, replay controls, and a full-video request form.
- **Make (`frontend/src/pages/Make.tsx`)** — Guides visitors through paper retrieval, script generation, evidence checks, and playback. Supports English and Chinese, displays progress, and offers a retry on rate limits.
- **Preview generation (`frontend/src/lib/makePreview.ts`)** — Retrieves paper details and text, generates a script, checks scene evidence and numbers, and prepares the player. Uses the HTML-suffixed scene prompt path.
- **Demo data and player (`frontend/src/lib/demos.ts`, `frontend/public/explainer/`)** — Loads demo metadata from `index.json.html` and builds player script paths using `script_<lang>.json.html`. The updated player supports HTML-suffixed asset paths.
- **Player and review (`frontend/src/lib/usePlayerEnded.ts`)** — Supports player completion behavior. The Make page uses the shared player in waiting mode, with language switching and replay, followed by an evidence review and draft disclaimer.
- **Request panel (`frontend/src/components/RequestPanel.tsx`)** — Shared full-video request form, including on the Make page with the paper’s arXiv ID prefilled.
- **Latest previews API and persistence** — Backend routes, models, services, and migration save made-preview metadata and retrieve recent previews. A failed save does not prevent playback.
- **Authentication and preferences** — Frontend auth context and theme/language preferences; backend auth and user modules. Previews and requests are available to anonymous visitors.
- **Supporting APIs** — Health, settings, storage, and AI Hub routes and services.
- **Blog and prerendering** — Blog routes, article components, and prerender utilities are included in the frontend.

# Directory Tree
```text
app/
├── .mgx/config.yaml                  # Project configuration
├── start_app_v2.sh                   # App startup helper
├── backend/
│   ├── main.py                       # FastAPI application entry point
│   ├── lambda_handler.py             # Serverless handler
│   ├── requirements.txt              # Backend dependencies
│   ├── alembic.ini                   # Database migration configuration
│   ├── alembic/versions/              # Database migrations
│   ├── core/                         # Configuration, auth, database, telemetry
│   ├── dependencies/                 # Shared API dependencies
│   ├── models/                       # Full-video request and made-preview models
│   ├── schemas/                      # API request and response schemas
│   ├── routers/                      # API endpoints
│   ├── services/                     # Database and business logic
│   ├── data_models/                  # Data model definitions
│   ├── skills_docs/                  # Integration and SDK guidance
│   └── utils/                        # Logging helpers
└── frontend/
    ├── package.json                  # Frontend scripts and dependencies
    ├── vite.config.ts                # Vite configuration
    ├── site.config.json              # Site configuration
    ├── public/
    │   ├── explainer/
    │   │   ├── player.html           # Bundled player with HTML asset fallback
    │   │   ├── index.json            # Original demo metadata
    │   │   ├── index.json.html       # Production-compatible demo metadata
    │   │   ├── scene_prompt.md       # Original scene prompt
    │   │   ├── scene_prompt.md.html  # Production-compatible scene prompt
    │   │   └── <arxiv-id>/           # Demo scripts, HTML copies, and narration
    │   └── favicon.svg, robots.txt   # Public site assets
    ├── prerender/                    # Blog prerender and sitemap utilities
    └── src/
        ├── App.tsx                   # App routes and shell
        ├── pages/                    # Home, Watch, and Make pages
        ├── components/               # Shared forms and home sections
        ├── contexts/                 # Authentication context
        ├── api/                      # API helpers
        ├── lib/                      # Preview generation, demos, preferences
        ├── hooks/                    # Shared React hooks
        └── *.css                     # Global and app styles
attachments/
├── explainer-bundle.zip              # Original player and demo bundle
└── explainer-bundle-v2.zip           # Updated player and HTML-suffixed assets
```

# File Description Inventory
- `backend/routers/full_video_requests.py` — Full-video request submission API.
- `backend/models/full_video_requests.py` — Persistent full-video request model.
- `backend/routers/made_previews.py` — Made-preview API, including recent preview retrieval.
- `backend/models/made_previews.py` — Made-preview database model.
- `backend/services/made_previews.py` — Made-preview persistence and retrieval logic.
- `backend/data_models/made_previews.json` — Made-preview data model.
- `backend/alembic/versions/` — Database migrations, including the made-preview schema.
- `backend/schemas/` — API data validation and serialization.
- `backend/services/full_video_requests.py` — Full-video request handling logic.
- `frontend/src/pages/Index.tsx` — Home page with demo cards and own-paper section.
- `frontend/src/pages/Watch.tsx` — Demo player and full-video request form.
- `frontend/src/pages/Make.tsx` — Own-paper preview generation, playback, and evidence review.
- `frontend/src/components/OwnPaperSection.tsx` — arXiv input and latest-preview list.
- `frontend/src/components/RequestPanel.tsx` — Reusable full-video request form.
- `frontend/src/lib/demos.ts` — Demo metadata loading and demo data helpers; uses `index.json.html`.
- `frontend/src/lib/makePreview.ts` — Paper retrieval, AI script generation, evidence checks, and player integration; uses the HTML-suffixed scene prompt.
- `frontend/src/lib/usePlayerEnded.ts` — Player completion hook.
- `frontend/public/explainer/player.html` — Bundled player with fallback support for HTML-suffixed assets.
- `frontend/public/explainer/index.json.html` — Production-compatible demo metadata.
- `frontend/public/explainer/scene_prompt.md.html` — Production-compatible scene prompt.
- `frontend/public/explainer/<arxiv-id>/script_<lang>.json.html` — Production-compatible demo scripts for English and Chinese.
- `frontend/public/explainer/<arxiv-id>/` — Demo scripts and narration audio.
- `frontend/prerender/` — Blog page and sitemap generation helpers.
- `frontend/plugins/` — Development guards and associated tests.
- `frontend/DESIGN.md` — Frontend design guidance.

# Technology Stack
- **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and a shared UI component library.
- **Backend:** Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and Alembic.
- **Data:** Relational database configured through the backend; full-video requests and made-preview metadata are persisted there.
- **Paper and script services:** Browser-side requests to paper retrieval and AI script-generation services; service keys are not stored in the app.
- **Media:** Static scripts and MP3 narration served from frontend assets. Made previews use browser speech synthesis.
- **Testing and quality:** ESLint, Playwright configuration, and plugin tests.

# Usage
1. Install backend dependencies:
   ```bash
   cd app/backend
   pip install -r requirements.txt
   ```
2. Install frontend dependencies:
   ```bash
   cd app/frontend
   npm install
   ```
3. Configure the required database and application settings. Do not put secrets or keys in frontend code.
4. Apply database migrations from `app/backend`:
   ```bash
   alembic upgrade head
   ```
5. Start the app using the repository helper:
   ```bash
   ./app/start_app_v2.sh
   ```
   Alternatively, start the backend with `uvicorn main:app --reload` from `app/backend` and the frontend with `npm run dev` from `app/frontend`.
6. Build the frontend from `app/frontend`:
   ```bash
   npm run build
   ```
   Check `package.json` for additional build and lint scripts.
